description: This file is a shell script intended for performance testing of git repository operations, specifically tag-following with many tags. It includes setup procedures for creating repositories, histories, and tags, as well as performance test execution commands.

methods.name: create_history
methods.description: Creates a long history of commits with specified branch, number of commits, and blob content.

methods.name: create_tags
methods.description: Creates tags for each commit in the given revision range.
